description:
Find provisions by their text: which articles, points or clauses say X.

Every word of `text` must appear (quote it for an exact phrase). Searches the
text as published on `on_date` (default today); `nreg` limits it to acts. Each
hit is the smallest unit holding it, with that day's `urn`. ⟦ ⟧ in `excerpt`
mark matches, not the law's text. `amending_act` hits restate other acts.
`search` finds acts by title.

per_act.description: Hits per act, 0: all (default 3; 1 act: all).

name: ua_law__search_units
title: Search Legislation Provisions by Text
